query:
UPDATE molecules SET 
  radar_intensity = 55,
  radar_freshness = 40,
  radar_warmth = 50,
  radar_sweetness = 20,
  radar_spiciness = 25,
  radar_earthiness = 95
WHERE (olfactiveProfile LIKE '%terre%' OR olfactiveProfile LIKE '%earth%' OR olfactiveProfile LIKE '%mousse%' OR olfactiveProfile LIKE '%moss%' OR olfactiveProfile LIKE '%humus%' OR olfactiveProfile LIKE '%soil%')
  AND radar_intensity = 50 AND radar_freshness = 50
